dataset.name: Schema-validated coupling adapters and integrated null no-propagation control
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V10N. Implement reusable, solver-neutral typed contracts for all nine frozen V10N interfaces. Verify one valid record and one deliberately invalid missing-field record per interface. Recompute a small set of exact cached invariants without rerunning their source models. Execute a deterministic zero-input sentinel from impact kinematics through a synthetic CONTROL_NO_PROPAGATION outcome and a Blender card-only release record. This is a software integration control, not a WTC 1 event scenario, collapse prediction, non-collapse prediction, physical assignment, solver run, GPU job or Blender run.

epistemic_separation.observed_facts: File hashes, cached fields, arithmetic replay and software validator outcomes.
epistemic_separation.official_model_results: No official-model field is promoted; dependencies retain their prior labels.
epistemic_separation.model_hypotheses: All zero values and the 293.15 K reference are software sentinels, not WTC properties.
epistemic_separation.derived_results: Nine positive validations, nine negative rejections, deterministic trace and zero-input terminal control.
epistemic_separation.unknowns: All physical impact, fire, thermal, structural, initiation and propagation states remain unresolved.

next_iteration.objective: Instantiate a bounded three-track impact-to-damage handoff using only a zero-input software control, official-model-dependent damage references and an explicit UNKNOWN_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE branch. Verify available mass, energy and momentum ledgers without reopening the unqualified explicit physical solver branch or presenting an official-model damage mask as independent evidence.
